arms.B2_linear_all_4_features: OLS linear in the 4 DoE features
arms.D1_rule1_vernetzung_fitfree: declared a-priori baseline, score = Vernetzung (Wicks, Jones, Pappas 2007 Ch. 24)
arms.P1_guth_gold_1938: Guth & Gold 1938 5-param bounded least_squares (identical to parent receipts)
arms.R1_box_wilson_1951_quadratic_rsm: Box & Wilson 1951 full second-order response surface, 15 param OLS

attack_axis: post-hoc model/arm selection (winner's curse), orthogonal to the prior three attacks' axes (test-resample CI, train-refit CI, cluster-count FPR calibration)
claim_scope: Statistical-methodology audit only (post-hoc model/arm-selection bias), restricted to the Purformance HTE 2K-PUR lacquer scratch-hardness leak-free 58-observation benchmark. Does not modify or delete any prior receipt; reports whether the module's surviving significance claim is robust to a multiplicity correction and a selection-stability check that the three prior attacks did not perform. Grants no batch-release, qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority. n=58 leak-free observations from a single formulator and a single instrument.
honest_interpretation: WINNER'S-CURSE / POST-HOC ARM-SELECTION ATTACK on 'guth_gold_directional_concordance_exceeds_chance_leak_free'. Point-estimate reproduction: Guth-Gold C_obs=0.7111307420 (parent-receipted 0.7111307420, match=True); observed best arm on point estimate = B2_linear_all_4_features (Guth-Gold is best = False). SELECTION STABILITY (nested train-refit bootstrap, 2000 replicates, identical mechanics to guth-gold-nested-refit-bootstrap-v1 but scoring all 6 arms per replicate and recording the per-replicate argmax): win counts = {"B0_constant_mean": 0, "D1_rule1_vernetzung_fitfree": 2, "B2_linear_all_4_features": 598, "P1_guth_gold_1938": 1121, "R1_box_wilson_1951_quadratic_rsm": 279, "M1_histgbm_default": 0}. Guth-Gold wins 1121/2000 replicates (0.5605) -- criterion (a) requires >= 0.50: PASSES. MULTIPLICITY-CORRECTED CI: Guth-Gold's own nested-bootstrap concordance distribution has a nominal 95% CI [0.6369, 0.7270] (matches guth-gold-nested-refit-bootstrap-v1 methodology) and a Bonferroni alpha/6-corrected 99.1667% CI [0.6128, 0.7341] -- criterion (b) requires lower bound > 0.5: PASSES. VERDICT: this attack the claim SURVIVES the claim (criterion a PASSES, criterion b PASSES; REFUTED if either fails). POSITIVE CONTROL (planted defect = y permutation-shuffled, identical pipeline): under the shuffled null, win counts = {"B0_constant_mean": 0, "D1_rule1_vernetzung_fitfree": 1276, "B2_linear_all_4_features": 179, "P1_guth_gold_1938": 27, "R1_box_wilson_1951_quadratic_rsm": 112, "M1_histgbm_default": 406}; Guth-Gold wins 27/2000 (0.0135, below 0.50); the shuffled-data nominal best arm is D1_rule1_vernetzung_fitfree with win fraction 0.6380 and Bonferroni CI [0.5241, 0.5241] (EXCLUDES chance). Positive control detected the planted defect: True -- the identical machinery that reports Guth-Gold stable+significant on real labels correctly reports instability/non-significance on labels with the true relationship destroyed, so the real-data result is not an artifact of a selection-stability test that always passes.

nested_bootstrap.method: nested train-refit bootstrap identical to guth-gold-nested-refit-bootstrap-v1, extended to score all 6 arms per replicate and record the per-replicate argmax-concordance winner

positive_control.how_planted: np.random.default_rng(0).shuffle(y) applied once to the full 58-row target vector before re-running the identical nested train-refit bootstrap + 6-arm selection-stability + Bonferroni-corrected-CI pipeline used for the real-label analysis above
positive_control.planted_defect: target labels y permutation-shuffled (destroys true feature-target relationship by construction, same X and fold structure retained)

protocol: leave-one-iteration-out over the 58 leak-free unique (feature,target) observations (identical dedup construction as split-integrity-dedup-v1), folds 17/26/15
refutation_criterion: guth_gold_directional_concordance_exceeds_chance_leak_free is REFUTED under this post-hoc-selection attack if EITHER (a) Guth-Gold's win fraction across 2000 nested train-refit bootstrap replicates (winner = highest concordance of 6 candidate arms per replicate) is < 0.50, indicating the 'best arm' declaration is not a robust, reproducible characterization of the dataset, OR (b) the Bonferroni alpha/6-corrected (0.008333) nested-bootstrap percentile CI for Guth-Gold's own concordance has a lower bound <= 0.5 (chance), indicating the significance claim does not survive a multiplicity correction for having compared 6 arms post hoc before selecting Guth-Gold to test.
